keyword: order LZ-80 high or low pressure mode

title.en: The LZ-80 Order Has to Name High Pressure or Low Pressure
title.zh: LZ-80 的订单必须写明高压或低压

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints LZ-80 with two modes: high pressure ≤ 65 m³/h at ≤ 35 MPa, and low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h at ≤ 22 MPa. Delivery height says consult the factory standard.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台给 LZ-80 印了两种模式：高压 ≤ 65 m³/h、≤ 35 MPa，低压 ≤ 95 m³/h、≤ 22 MPa。输送高度写的是咨询工厂标准。

h1.en: Name the LZ-80 Mode in the Same Sentence as the Output
h1.zh: 把 LZ-80 的模式和输送量写在同一句里

directAnswer.en: An LZ-80 purchase from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai is incomplete if it says only “95” or only “65”. The sheet prints Yuchai 256 kW, high pressure ≤ 65 m³/h and ≤ 35 MPa, low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h and ≤ 22 MPa, hopper 0.6 m³, conveying distance 120 m, aggregate 6 cm and below, outline 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m and 6800 kg. Delivery height is the phrase “consult factory standard”, not a metre you may invent. Diesel 120’s 100 m³/h is not the low-pressure cell. Send the mode and the path to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/).
directAnswer.zh: 向河北品锦机械（邢台）采购 LZ-80 时，如果只写“95”或只写“65”，订单是不完整的。该页印玉柴 256 kW，高压 ≤ 65 m³/h 和 ≤ 35 MPa，低压 ≤ 95 m³/h 和 ≤ 22 MPa，料斗 0.6 m³，输送距离 120 m，骨料 6 cm 及以下，外形 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m，6800 kg。输送高度是“咨询工厂标准”这句话，不是你可以编造的米数。柴油120的 100 m³/h 不是低压格。把模式和路径发到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。

body.en: Both output and pressure use ≤. The order copies the mark.
body.zh: 输送量和压力都使用 ≤。订单照抄这个符号。

heading.zh: 与 LZ-60 相同的外形字符串

body.en: Both print 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m. LZ-60 is 5500 kg and 145 kW. LZ-80 is 6800 kg and 256 kW. The outline does not choose the mode.
body.zh: 两者都印 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m。LZ-60 是 5500 kg、145 kW。LZ-80 是 6800 kg、256 kW。外形选不出模式。

body.en: Ask Xingtai after the mode is named.

question.en: Can I write a vertical metre?
question.zh: 可以写一个垂直米数吗？

answer.en: Not as a catalogue cell. The sheet says to consult the factory standard.
answer.zh: 不能写成目录格。该页写的是咨询工厂标准。

answer.en: Diesel 120 prints two 145 kW units and does not name Yuchai on the sheet used here.
answer.zh: 柴油120印两台 145 kW，此处使用的表上没有写玉柴。

alt.zh: LZ-80 柴油混凝土泵，由河北品锦机械厂家制造，邢台
